en.s: First Battle of Tarain, also known as the First Battle of Taraori, was fought on 14 January 1191 between the Ghurid forces led by Muhammad of Ghor and the Rajput Confederacy led by Prithviraj Chauhan, near Tarain (modern Taraori in Haryana, India). The battle ended in a victory for the Rajputs; however, Muhammad of Ghor managed to escape and returned to Ghazni.

zh.s: 1191年1月14日，穆罕默德·古里率领的古尔王朝军队，与普里特维拉杰·乔汉率领的拉杰普特联盟，在塔兰附近交战。当地今称塔拉奥里，位于印度哈里亚纳邦。此战也称第一次塔拉奥里战役，以拉杰普特人获胜告终，但穆罕默德·古里成功逃脱，返回加兹尼。

en.s: The Capture of Baghdad occurred on 14 January 1624. Which was a conflict between the military of Abbas I of Persia against Murad IV of Turkey.

zh.s: 1624年1月14日，波斯阿巴斯一世的军队与土耳其穆拉德四世的军队交战，发生攻占巴格达事件。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Battle of the Lines of Elvas
en.s: The Battle of the Lines of Elvas (Portuguese pronunciation: [ˈɛlvɐʃ]), was fought on 14 January 1659, in Elvas, between Portugal and Spain during the Portuguese Restoration War. It ended in a decisive Portuguese victory achieved by commanders António Meneses and André Ribafria.

zh.s: 1659年1月14日，葡萄牙与西班牙在埃尔瓦斯交战，这是葡萄牙复国战争的一部分。安东尼奥·梅内塞斯与安德烈·里巴弗里亚指挥葡军取得决定性胜利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Third Battle of Panipat took place on 14 January 1761, at Panipat, about 60 miles (97 km) north of Delhi between a northern expeditionary force of the Maratha Empire and the invading forces of the King of Afghanistan, Ahmad Shah Abdali, supported by two Indian allies—the Rohilla Afghans of the Doab, and Shuja-ud-Daula, the Nawab of Awadh. Militarily, the battle pitted the French origin artillery and cavalry of the Marathas against the heavy cavalry and mounted artillery (zamburak and jizail) of the Afghans and Rohillas led by Ahmad Shah Abdali and Najib-ud-Daulah, both ethnic Afghans (the former is also known as Ahmad Shah Durrani).

zh.s: 1761年1月14日，马拉塔帝国的北征军，与阿富汗国王艾哈迈德沙·阿卜达利的入侵军，在德里以北约60英里、即97公里的帕尼帕特交战。阿富汗一方还得到两个印度盟友支持：多阿布地区的罗希拉阿富汗人，以及奥德纳瓦卜舒贾·乌德·道拉。马拉塔军使用源自法国的炮兵与骑兵体系，对抗艾哈迈德沙和纳吉布·乌德·道拉率领的阿富汗及罗希拉重骑兵、骑载火器部队，包括骆驼旋转炮和长管火枪。两位指挥官都是阿富汗族人，艾哈迈德沙·阿卜达利也称艾哈迈德沙·杜兰尼。

en.s: The Battle of Sirhind was fought between Durrani Empire and Sikh Misls on 14 January 1764.

zh.s: 1764年1月14日，杜兰尼帝国与锡克各米斯尔军事集团在西尔欣德交战。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Huilliche uprising of 1792 was an indigenous uprising against the Spanish penetration into Futahuillimapu, a territory in southern Chile that had been de facto free of Spanish rule since 1602. The first part of the conflict was a series of Huilliche attacks on Spanish settlers and the mission in the frontier next to Bueno River.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1792年，维利切人发动起义，反抗西班牙人向智利南部富塔维利马普地区扩张。这片土地自1602年以来事实上未受西班牙统治。冲突初期，维利切人接连袭击布埃诺河边境一带的西班牙定居者及传教站。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: Jared Irwin elected governor of Georgia
en.s: On January 14, 1796, Jared Irwin was elected governor of Georgia in an unopposed vote of the Georgia General Assembly. He was the Democratic-Republican nominee. The source article names the contest the 1795 Georgia gubernatorial election, but dates the actual legislative vote to January 14, 1796.

zh.t: 贾里德·欧文当选佐治亚州州长
zh.s: 1796年1月14日，民主共和党候选人贾里德·欧文在佐治亚州议会的无竞争投票中当选州长。来源条目将这次选举称为“1795年佐治亚州州长选举”，但实际议会投票日期为1796年1月14日。

en.s: The Battle of Rivoli (14–15 January 1797) was a key victory in the French campaign in Italy against Austria. Napoleon Bonaparte's 23,000 Frenchmen defeated an attack of 28,000 Austrians under Feldzeugmeister Jozsef Alvinczi, ending Austria's fourth and final attempt to relieve the Siege of Mantua. Rivoli further demonstrated Napoleon's brilliance as a military commander and led to French occupation of northern Italy.

zh.s: 1797年1月14日至15日，法军在意大利对奥地利作战期间取得里沃利关键胜利。拿破仑·波拿巴率领23,000名法军，击败约瑟夫·阿尔文齐炮兵上将统率的28,000名奥军，终结奥地利为曼图亚解围的第四次、也是最后一次尝试。里沃利之战进一步展现拿破仑的军事指挥才能，并促成法国占领意大利北部。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The action of 13 January 1797 (known by the French as the Naufrage du Droits de l'Homme; "shipwreck [or sinking] of the Droits de l'Homme") was a minor naval battle fought between a French ship of the line and two British frigates off the coast of Brittany during the French Revolutionary Wars.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1797年1月13日，法国大革命战争期间，一艘法国战列舰与两艘英国护卫舰在布列塔尼近海交战。这是一场规模较小的海战，法方称其为“人权号沉没事件”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: 1802 United States Senate special election in Delaware
en.s: The 1802 United States Senate special election in Delaware was held on January 14, 1802. Senator Henry Latimer had resigned after becoming unhappy over the tactics of his political opponents who were still bitter over the circumstances of the contested election in 1792. Samuel White defeated Archibald Alexander, who had previously failed to win gubernatorial and House elections, by 10 votes.

zh.t: 1802年美国特拉华州联邦参议员特别选举
zh.s: 1802年1月14日，特拉华州举行联邦参议员特别选举。参议员亨利·拉蒂默因不满政治对手的手段而辞职，对手们仍对1792年那场有争议选举的情况耿耿于怀。塞缪尔·怀特以十票优势击败阿奇博尔德·亚历山大；后者此前也曾在州长和众议员选举中失利。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The Portuguese conquest of French Guiana, also known as Conquest of Cayenne (Portuguese: Conquista de Caiena), was the capture of the French colony of Cayenne by Anglo-Portuguese forces in January 1809 during the Napoleonic Wars. It formed part of the Caribbean campaign of 1803–1810, a British-led campaign against the colonies of France and its allies during the conflict.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 葡萄牙征服法属圭亚那
zh.s: 葡萄牙征服法属圭亚那又称征服卡宴（葡萄牙语：Conquista de Caiena），是拿破仑战争期间，英葡联军于1809年1月攻占法国卡宴殖民地的行动。它属于1803年至1810年加勒比战役的一部分；这场战役由英国主导，针对法国及其盟友的殖民地展开。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Treaty of Kiel (Danish: Kieltraktaten) or Peace of Kiel (Swedish and Norwegian: Kielfreden or freden i Kiel) was concluded between the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland and the Kingdom of Sweden on one side and the Kingdoms of Denmark and Norway on the other side on 14 January 1814 in Kiel.

zh.s: 1814年1月14日，大不列颠及爱尔兰联合王国与瑞典王国为一方，丹麦和挪威两王国为另一方，在基尔缔结《基尔条约》，也称《基尔和约》。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: The Battle of Fort Point Peter was a successful attack in early 1815 by a British force on a smaller American force on the Georgia side of the St. Marys River near St. Marys, Georgia. The river was then part of the international border between the United States and British-allied Spanish Florida; it now forms part of the boundary between Georgia and Florida.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1815年初，一支英军在佐治亚州圣玛丽斯附近、圣玛丽斯河北岸进攻规模较小的美军，并取得胜利。当时，这条河是美国与英国盟友西属佛罗里达之间的国际边界；如今则构成佐治亚州与佛罗里达州边界的一部分。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: Battle of Bellavista was the final confrontation of the Chilean 1826 campaign to successfully dislodge the Royalists from Chiloé Archipelago.

zh.s: 贝拉维斯塔战役是智利1826年奇洛埃战役的最后一次交锋。智利军队在这次战役中成功将保王派逐出奇洛埃群岛。

en.t: 1839–1840 United States Senate election in New York
en.s: The 1839—1840 United States Senate election in New York was held on February 5, 1839, and January 14, 1840. Incumbent Senator Nathaniel P. Tallmadge was re-elected to a second term in office over scattered opposition. Though his first election was as a Jacksonian Democrat, Tallmadge left the Democrats in 1838 to join a "Conservative" faction in support of the new Whig Party ticket led by William Seward.
en.n: This entry records the listed event date, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 纽约州在1839年2月5日及1840年1月14日举行联邦参议员选举。现任参议员纳撒尼尔·P.塔尔米奇面对分散的反对力量，获连任并开始第二个任期。他最初以杰克逊派民主党人身份当选，但于1838年离开民主党，加入支持威廉·西沃德领导的新辉格党候选人阵容的“保守派”。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列出的投票日期。

en.t: United States Senate election in Pennsylvania, 1851
en.s: The 1851 United States Senate election in Pennsylvania was held on January 14, 1851. Richard Brodhead was elected by the Pennsylvania General Assembly to the United States Senate.

zh.t: 1851年美国宾夕法尼亚州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1851年1月14日，宾夕法尼亚州举行联邦参议员选举，州议会选出理查德·布罗德黑德担任联邦参议员。

en.t: Orsini assassination attempt against Napoleon III
en.s: On the evening of 14 January 1858, conspirators threw three bombs at the carriage carrying Napoleon III and Empress Eugénie as they travelled to the opera in Paris. The emperor and empress escaped unharmed. The plot was led by the Italian nationalist Felice Orsini.

zh.t: 奥尔西尼刺杀拿破仑三世未遂
zh.s: 1858年1月14日晚，拿破仑三世与欧仁妮皇后乘车前往巴黎歌剧院途中，密谋者向御驾投掷3枚炸弹，皇帝与皇后均未受伤。此次阴谋由意大利民族主义者费利切·奥尔西尼领导。

en.s: The 1860–61 United States Senate elections were held from January 14, 1860, to April 2, 1861. Regularly scheduled elections were held for 23 out of the 68 seats in the United States Senate, and special elections were held in California, Oregon, Maine, Pennsylvania, and Ohio. One seat was previously elected on December 12, 1859.

zh.s: 1860年1月14日至1861年4月2日，美国举行参议院选举，68个席位中的23席按期改选。加利福尼亚、俄勒冈、缅因、宾夕法尼亚及俄亥俄州还举行特别选举。另有一个席位已提前于1859年12月12日选出。

en.s: The Battle of Canyon de Chelly was fought in 1864 as part of the Navajo Wars. It was a successful operation for the United States Army which precipitated the Long Walk and was the final major military engagement between the Navajo and the Americans. The battle ended with the fall of the main Navajo settlements of Canyon de Chelly in present-day northern Arizona.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1864年，纳瓦霍战争期间爆发谢伊峡谷战役。这次美军行动取得胜利，促成了纳瓦霍人的“长途迁徙”，也是纳瓦霍人与美军之间最后一次重大军事交锋。战役以纳瓦霍人位于今亚利桑那州北部谢伊峡谷的主要聚落失守告终。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Malta between 9 and 14 January 1865.

zh.s: 1865年1月9日至14日，马耳他举行大选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The American Ranch massacre occurred in 1865 during the Colorado War. Cheyenne and Sioux warriors attacked a ranch near present-day Sterling, Colorado where they killed all of the male settlers and took three captives.

zh.s: 1865年科罗拉多战争期间，夏延族和苏族战士袭击了位于今科罗拉多州斯特灵附近的一座牧场，杀死所有男性定居者，并俘获3人。事件被称为“美洲牧场惨案”。

en.s: The siege of Lapa was a military confrontation involving the Brazilian Army, the National Guard, the Military Police of Paraná state and civilian volunteers, which took place during the Federalist Revolution in early 1894. The city of Lapa became the arena of a bloody confrontation between the loyalist republican troops, commonly called pica-paus (woodpeckers) against the maragatos, federalist rebels, who opposed the presidential form of government.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1894年初，巴西联邦革命期间，巴西陆军、国民警卫队、巴拉那州军警及平民志愿者卷入拉帕围城战。拉帕城内，通常被称为“啄木鸟”的共和派政府军，与反对总统制、被称为“马拉加托”的联邦派叛军展开血战。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.s: Giacomo Puccini’s opera Tosca premiered at the Teatro Costanzi in Rome on 14 January 1900. The three-act opera has an Italian libretto by Luigi Illica and Giuseppe Giacosa, based on Victorien Sardou’s play La Tosca.

zh.t: 普契尼歌剧《托斯卡》首演
zh.s: 1900年1月14日，贾科莫·普契尼的歌剧《托斯卡》在罗马科斯坦齐剧院首演。这部三幕歌剧由路易吉·伊利卡和朱塞佩·贾科萨编写意大利文脚本，改编自维克托里安·萨尔杜的戏剧《托斯卡》。

en.s: A magnitude 6.2 earthquake struck Jamaica's capital, Kingston, on the afternoon of January 14. Strong shaking and fires devastated the city; the article reports that every building was damaged and that roughly 1,000 people died. Fires spread for hours before effective efforts to contain them could begin. A tsunami was also reported along Jamaica's north coast. The disaster caused extensive property losses and remains one of the Caribbean's most destructive recorded earthquakes. The dedicated article cites earthquake databases and contemporary reporting for the event's time, location, casualties and effects.

zh.t: 牙买加金斯敦遭地震重创
zh.s: 1月14日下午，牙买加首都金斯敦发生6.2级地震。强烈震动和火灾重创城市；专题文章记载，所有建筑均受损，约1,000人死亡。火势持续蔓延数小时，之后才开始得到有效控制。牙买加北海岸还报告发生海啸。灾难造成重大财产损失，至今仍是加勒比地区有记录以来破坏最严重的地震之一。相关专题文章引用地震数据库及当时报道，说明事件的时间、地点、伤亡与影响。

en.t: Start of the 1908–09 United States Senate election cycle
en.s: The 1908–09 United States Senate election cycle began on January 14, 1908, and extended through July 6, 1909, with contests held on different dates in different states. Before the Seventeenth Amendment was ratified in 1913, senators were primarily chosen by state legislatures. This entry marks the start of that cycle, not a single nationwide polling day.

zh.t: 1908—1909年美国参议院选举周期开始
zh.s: 1908—1909年美国参议院选举周期于1908年1月14日开始，延续至1909年7月6日，各州在不同日期分别选举。1913年宪法第十七修正案获批准之前，参议员主要由州议会选出。此条记录这一选举周期的开始，并非全国在同一天统一投票。

en.s: The 1911 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship final was a Gaelic football match played at Jones's Road on 14 January 1912 to determine the winners of the 1911 All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, the 25th season of the All-Ireland Senior Football Championship, a tournament organised by the Gaelic Athletic Association for the champions of the four provinces of Ireland.

zh.t: 1911届全爱尔兰盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1912年1月14日，1911届全爱尔兰成年组盖尔式足球锦标赛决赛在琼斯路球场举行，决出该届冠军。这是锦标赛的第25个赛季，由盖尔运动协会组织，参赛者为爱尔兰四省的冠军球队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: 1913 United States Senate election in Massachusetts
en.s: The 1913 United States Senate election in Massachusetts was held during January 1913. Incumbent Republican Senator Winthrop Crane retired and was succeeded by Republican John Wingate Weeks. At the time, Massachusetts elected United States senators by a majority vote of the combined houses of the Massachusetts General Court.

zh.t: 1913年马萨诸塞州联邦参议员选举
zh.s: 1913年1月，马萨诸塞州举行联邦参议员选举。共和党现任参议员温思罗普·克兰退休后，由同党的约翰·温盖特·威克斯接任。当时，马萨诸塞州的联邦参议员由州议会两院联席会议以过半数票选出。

en.s: The Battle of Humin-Bolimów was an inconclusive battle of World War I fought between January 14 and February 28, 1915 between the Imperial German Army and Russia. The battle is considered a preliminary to the Second Battle of the Masurian Lakes.
en.n: This entry records the event's start date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1915年1月14日至2月28日，德意志帝国军队与俄军在第一次世界大战期间展开胡明—博利莫夫战役，双方未分胜负。这场战役被视为第二次马祖里湖战役的前奏。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件开始日期。

en.t: January 1920 New Zealand Liberal Party leadership election
en.s: An election for the leadership of the New Zealand Liberal Party was held on 14 January 1920 to choose the next leader of the party. The election was won by Bay of Plenty MP and acting party leader William MacDonald.

zh.t: 1920年1月新西兰自由党党首选举
zh.s: 1920年1月14日，新西兰自由党举行党首选举，丰盛湾选区议员、代理党首威廉·麦克唐纳获胜。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in El Salvador on 14 January 1923. The result was a victory for Alfonso Quiñónez Molina, who was the only candidate.

zh.s: 1923年1月14日，萨尔瓦多举行总统选举，唯一候选人阿方索·基尼奥内斯·莫利纳获胜。

en.s: The 1934 Barcelona City Council election was held on Sunday, 14 January 1934, to elect the Barcelona City Council, the unicameral local legislature of the municipality of Barcelona, together with the other 1,029 Catalan municipalities. At stake were all 40 seats in the City Council, determining the Mayor of Barcelona. These were the first local elections where women were able to vote.

zh.s: 1934年1月14日星期日，巴塞罗那与加泰罗尼亚其他1,029个市镇同时举行地方选举，改选市议会全部40个席位，并由此决定市长人选。市议会是巴塞罗那市的一院制地方立法机构。这是女性首次能够投票的地方选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 1934 Catalan local elections were held on 14 January to elect the municipal councils in all the 1,029 municipalities of Catalonia. These elections were only held in Catalonia, as the 1932 Statute of Autonomy devolved the competences on local elections to the Generalitat de Catalunya. These were the first and only election to be organised by the Catalan Government, since this administration was suppressed by the Dictatorship of Francisco Franco in 1939, after winning the Spanish Civil War.

zh.s: 1934年1月14日，加泰罗尼亚举行地方选举，选出全部1029个市镇的议会。由于1932年《自治法》将地方选举权限移交加泰罗尼亚政府，选举仅在该地区举行。这是当时的自治政府主持的首次、也是唯一一次地方选举；该政府在佛朗哥赢得西班牙内战后，于1939年遭到撤销。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: On 14 January 1939, Norway claimed Queen Maud Land in Antarctica as a dependent territory. This entry records Norway’s territorial claim, not universally recognised sovereignty over the Antarctic region.

zh.t: 挪威宣称拥有毛德皇后地主权
zh.s: 1939年1月14日，挪威宣布将南极洲的毛德皇后地作为其属地。此条记录挪威提出领土主张，并不表示该南极地区的主权获得普遍承认。

en.s: Operation Postmaster was a British special operation conducted on the Spanish island of Fernando Po, now known as Bioko, off West Africa in the Gulf of Guinea, during the Second World War. The mission was carried out by the Small Scale Raiding Force (SSRF) and the Special Operations Executive (SOE) in January 1942. Their objective was to board the Italian and German ships in the harbour and sail them to Lagos. The SSRF under the command of Major Gus March-Phillipps left Britain in August 1941 and sailed the Brixham trawler, Maid Honor, to the Spanish colony.

zh.s: 1942年1月，第二次世界大战期间，英国小规模突袭部队与特别行动执行处，在西非几内亚湾外海的西属费尔南多波岛，今比奥科岛，实施“邮政局长”特别行动。目标是登上港内的意大利和德国船只，将其开往拉各斯。小规模突袭部队由格斯·马奇-菲利普斯少校指挥，于1941年8月离开英国，乘布里克瑟姆渔船“Maid Honor”号驶往该西班牙殖民地。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: On 14 January 1942, Australian soldiers of the 2/30th Battalion ambushed Japanese troops at the Gemencheh Bridge near Gemas during the Japanese invasion of Malaya. The action formed part of the wider Battle of Muar in the Second World War.

zh.t: 澳军在金马士附近设伏
zh.s: 1942年1月14日，日军入侵马来亚期间，澳大利亚陆军第2/30营在金马士附近的金门沙桥伏击日军。这是第二次世界大战中麻坡战役的一部分。

en.t: Allied leaders begin the Casablanca Conference
en.s: The Casablanca Conference opened in French Morocco on January 14, bringing US president Franklin D. Roosevelt and British prime minister Winston Churchill together with their military staffs. The leaders discussed Allied strategy for the next phase of World War II. Their decisions included plans for operations in Sicily and Italy, a stronger bombing campaign against Germany and advances across the Pacific. The conference also produced a public commitment to seek the Axis powers' unconditional surrender. Soviet leader Joseph Stalin did not attend. The meeting continued until January 24, making this anniversary the start of the conference rather than the date of every decision.

zh.t: 盟国领导人开始卡萨布兰卡会议
zh.s: 1月14日，卡萨布兰卡会议在法属摩洛哥开幕。美国总统富兰克林·D.罗斯福、英国首相温斯顿·丘吉尔及双方军事参谋人员，共同讨论第二次世界大战下一阶段的盟军战略。会议决定包括在西西里和意大利开展行动、加强轰炸德国，以及在太平洋继续推进。与会者还公开承诺，寻求轴心国无条件投降。苏联领导人约瑟夫·斯大林没有出席。会议一直持续到1月24日，因此1月14日纪念的是开幕，而非所有决定作出的日期。

en.s: The Battle of Kumai (Indonesian: Pertempuran Kumai) or also known locally as the Battle of 14 January (Indonesian: Pertempuran 14 Januari) was a clash between Netherlands Indies Civil Administration and Royal Netherlands East Indies Army against Indonesian militias in town of Kumai, Central Kalimantan. Indonesian militias, consisted of mostly pemuda (youths), newly formed Indonesian Army, and armed Islamic cleric militia; known as Barisan Ulama (Ulema Front) or Barisan Berjenggot (Bearded Front), confronted Dutch armed convoys that tried to land in the port.

zh.s: 库迈战役在当地亦称“1月14日战役”，发生在中加里曼丹库迈镇。荷属东印度民政当局及荷属东印度皇家陆军，与印度尼西亚民兵发生冲突。由青年、新成立的印尼军队及被称为“乌里玛阵线”或“胡须阵线”的伊斯兰教士武装组成的民兵，迎击试图在港口登陆的荷兰武装车队。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The Battle of 3 Shevat took place during the 1947–1949 Palestine war on January 14, 1948 (Hebrew date: 3 Shevat). The battle began with a large attack on Gush Etzion by Arab groups in the area, reinforced by Arabs and Bedouins who came from as far as Jerusalem and Beer Sheva, under the command of Abd al-Qadir al-Husayni.

zh.s: 1948年1月14日，即希伯来历舍瓦特月初三，1947—1949年巴勒斯坦战争期间爆发一场战役。阿卜杜勒·卡迪尔·侯赛尼指挥当地阿拉伯武装大举进攻古什埃齐翁，并得到远自耶路撒冷、贝尔谢巴赶来的阿拉伯人和贝都因人增援。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: National Airlines Flight 83 was a United States domestic flight from Newark International Airport, serving New York City, to Philadelphia. On January 14, 1951, the Douglas DC-4 of National Airlines crashed on landing at Philadelphia International Airport. The aircraft over-shot the runway, ran into a ditch and caught fire. Of the 28 people on board, 7 were killed and 11 injured.

zh.t: 美国国家航空83号班机空难
zh.s: 1951年1月14日，美国国家航空一架道格拉斯DC-4客机执行83号国内航班，由服务纽约市的纽瓦克机场飞往费城。客机在费城国际机场降落时冲出跑道、掉入沟渠并起火，机上28人中有7人死亡、11人受伤。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: Elections to the Kutch Electoral College took place in Kutch State, India, on January 14, 1952, which in turn elected one member of the Rajya Sabha (upper house of the Parliament of India). The election was won by the Indian National Congress, who obtained 28 out of 30 seats. Independents won the two remaining seats.

zh.s: 1952年1月14日，印度卡奇邦举行选举人团选举，再由该团选出一名联邦院，即印度议会上院议员。印度国大党取得30席中的28席，另外两席由独立候选人获得。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: Josip Broz Tito became president of Yugoslavia on 14 January 1953, succeeding Ivan Ribar as the country’s head of state. He had already served as prime minister; the presidency was a distinct office.

zh.t: 铁托就任南斯拉夫总统
zh.s: 1953年1月14日，约瑟普·布罗兹·铁托就任南斯拉夫总统，接替伊万·里巴尔成为国家元首。铁托此前已担任总理，总统则是另一个不同的职位。

en.t: The Reserve Bank of Australia, the country's central bank and banknote issuing authority authorized by the 1959 Reserve Bank Act, is established
en.s: The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) is Australia's central bank and banknote issuing authority. It has had this role since 14 January 1960, when the Reserve Bank Act 1959 removed the central banking functions from the Commonwealth Bank. The Bank's duty is to contribute to the stability of the currency, full employment, and the economic prosperity and welfare of the Australian people.

zh.t: 澳大利亚储备银行开始履行中央银行职能
zh.s: 1960年1月14日，《1959年储备银行法》将中央银行职能从澳大利亚联邦银行分离，交由澳大利亚储备银行承担。储备银行由此成为该国的中央银行和纸币发行机构，其职责是促进币值稳定、充分就业，以及澳大利亚人民的经济繁荣与福祉。

en.s: Operation Crimp (8–14 January 1966), also known as the Battle of the Ho Bo Woods, was a joint US-Australian military operation during the Vietnam War, which took place 20 kilometres (12 mi) north of Cu Chi in Binh Duong Province, South Vietnam.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1966年1月8日至14日，越南战争期间，美军与澳军联合发动克林普行动，亦称“霍博树林战役”。行动地点位于南越平阳省、古芝以北约20公里处。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: 1967 Emperor's Cup Final was the 47th final of the Emperor's Cup competition. The final was played at National Stadium in Tokyo on January 14, 1968. Toyo Industries won the cup.

zh.s: 1968年1月14日，第47届天皇杯决赛在东京国立竞技场举行。东洋工业队夺得冠军。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: On January 14, 1969, a major fire and a series of explosions aboard the aircraft carrier USS Enterprise off the coast of O'ahu, Hawaii, United States, led to the deaths of 28 sailors and injuries to 314 others. Additionally, 15 aircraft were destroyed in the incident. A Zuni rocket detonated under a plane's wing, causing a fire that touched off more munitions, blowing holes in the flight deck that allowed burning jet fuel to enter the ship. The cost of replacing the aircraft and repairing the ship cost over US$126 million (roughly $1 billion adjusted for inflation in 2022).

zh.t: 1969年美国“企业”号航空母舰火灾
zh.s: 1969年1月14日，美国“企业”号航空母舰在夏威夷瓦胡岛近海发生大火和连环爆炸，造成28名水兵死亡、314人受伤，15架飞机被毁。一枚飞机翼下的“祖尼”火箭弹爆炸引发火灾，继而引爆更多弹药，在飞行甲板上炸出破洞，让燃烧的航空燃油流入舰内。更换飞机及修复军舰的费用超过1.26亿美元，按2022年通胀水平折算约为十亿美元。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current lead via MediaWiki API

en.s: Margrethe II became Queen of Denmark on 14 January 1972 following the death of her father, Frederik IX. Her reign lasted exactly 52 years, ending with her abdication on 14 January 2024. This entry records her accession in 1972.

zh.s: 1972年1月14日，父亲腓特烈九世去世后，玛格丽特二世继位为丹麦女王。她在位整整52年，直到2024年1月14日退位。此条记录的是1972年的即位。

en.t: Elvis Presley’s Aloha from Hawaii concert
en.s: Elvis Presley performed Aloha from Hawaii via Satellite at the Honolulu International Center on January 14, 1973. The concert was transmitted live by satellite to audiences in Asia and Oceania, with a delayed showing in Europe. The United States television broadcast followed on April 4, rather than on the concert date.

zh.t: 猫王夏威夷卫星演唱会
zh.s: 1973年1月14日，埃尔维斯·普雷斯利在檀香山国际中心举行《来自夏威夷的问候》演唱会，并通过卫星向亚洲和大洋洲观众现场直播，欧洲观众则观看延时播出。美国电视转播在4月4日进行，并非演唱会当天。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Cameroon on 14 January 1984. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Cameroonian National Union as the sole legal party. Its leader, Paul Biya, was the only candidate in the election, and won unopposed. Voter turnout was 97.7%.

zh.s: 1984年1月14日，喀麦隆举行总统选举。当时该国实行一党制，喀麦隆民族联盟是唯一合法政党。该党领袖保罗·比亚作为唯一候选人，因无人竞争而当选。投票率为97.7%。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.t: Announcement of the demolition of Kowloon Walled City
en.s: On 14 January 1987, the British and Chinese governments announced their joint decision to demolish Kowloon Walled City in Hong Kong. The announcement did not mark the beginning of demolition work, which took place in 1993–1994.

zh.t: 中英宣布拆除九龙城寨
zh.s: 1987年1月14日，中英两国政府宣布共同决定拆除香港九龙城寨。当天只是公布决定，实际拆除工程在1993年至1994年进行。

en.s: MS Jan Heweliusz sank in the Baltic Sea on 14 January 1993 while sailing from Świnoujście, Poland, to Ystad, Sweden. The ferry sank during a severe storm. Published casualty totals differ; this entry records the sinking rather than presenting a disputed count as settled.

zh.s: 1993年1月14日，扬·赫维留号渡轮由波兰希维诺乌伊希切驶往瑞典于斯塔德途中，在猛烈风暴中沉没于波罗的海。不同公开资料记载的遇难人数有所差异，此条记录确认的沉船事件，不将有争议的数字写成定论。

en.t: Signing of the 1994 Trilateral Statement in Moscow
en.s: On 14 January 1994, U.S. President Bill Clinton, Russian President Boris Yeltsin and Ukrainian President Leonid Kravchuk signed the Trilateral Statement in Moscow. This was a separate agreement and occasion from the Budapest Memorandum signed in December 1994.

zh.s: 1994年1月14日，美国总统比尔·克林顿、俄罗斯总统鲍里斯·叶利钦与乌克兰总统列昂尼德·克拉夫丘克在莫斯科签署《三方声明》。这是另一份协议、另一次签署，与同年12月签署的《布达佩斯备忘录》不同。

en.s: A presidential election was held in Portugal on 14 January 1996. Incumbent president Mário Soares was constitutionally barred from a third consecutive term. The Social Democrats were coming from a clear defeat in the 1995 Portuguese legislative election, and their former leader, Aníbal Cavaco Silva, who had left the office of Prime Minister after 10 years at the helm, ran against the Mayor of Lisbon, Jorge Sampaio.

zh.s: 1996年1月14日，葡萄牙举行总统选举。现任总统马里奥·苏亚雷斯受宪法限制，不能连续第三次参选。社会民主党刚在1995年议会选举中明显落败，其前党魁阿尼巴尔·卡瓦科·席尔瓦，在担任总理十年后卸任，转而与里斯本市长若热·桑帕约竞争总统职位。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: The 2000 FIFA Club World Championship final was an association football match that took place at Estádio do Maracanã, Rio de Janeiro on 14 January 2000. It was an all-Brazilian final between Corinthians and Vasco da Gama to determine the winner of the 2000 FIFA Club World Championship. After a goalless 120 minutes, Corinthians won the penalty shoot-out 4–3, becoming the first club to lift the FIFA Club World Cup.

zh.t: 2000年国际足联俱乐部世界锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 2000年1月14日，国际足联俱乐部世界锦标赛决赛在里约热内卢马拉卡纳体育场举行，由巴西球队科林蒂安对阵瓦斯科达伽马。双方在120分钟内均未进球，科林蒂安最终以4比3赢得点球大战，成为首支夺得国际足联俱乐部世界杯冠军的球队。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Cape Verde on 14 January 2001. The result was a victory for the African Party for the Independence of Cape Verde, which won 40 of the 72 seats in the National Assembly, defeating the ruling Movement for Democracy.

zh.s: 2001年1月14日，佛得角举行议会选举。佛得角非洲独立党取得国民议会72席中的40席，击败执政的争取民主运动。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Sin was a professional wrestling pay-per-view event produced by World Championship Wrestling that replaced WCW's January PPV event, Souled Out. Sin was the antepenultimate WCW PPV before the company was absorbed by the World Wrestling Federation (WWF). It took place on January 14, 2001 from the Conseco Fieldhouse in Indianapolis, Indiana. The main event was for the WCW World Heavyweight Championship between Scott Steiner, Sid Vicious, Jeff Jarrett, and Animal in a Four Corners match.

zh.s: 2001年1月14日，世界冠军摔角联盟（WCW）在美国印第安纳州印第安纳波利斯的康赛科球馆举办按次付费赛事“罪恶”，取代原本1月举办的“Souled Out”。这是WCW被世界摔角联盟收购前的倒数第三场按次付费赛事。压轴赛是一场争夺WCW世界重量级冠军的四角赛，参赛者为斯科特·斯坦纳、席德·维舍斯、杰夫·贾勒特及Animal。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: A presidential election was held in Portugal on 14 January 2001. Incumbent president Jorge Sampaio was eliglbe to run for a second consecutive term, and was a candidate for re-election. Sampaio was easily re-elected for a second term, like what happened with Mário Soares and Ramalho Eanes, gathering 55% of the votes and winning all districts except Bragança.

zh.s: 2001年1月14日，葡萄牙举行总统选举。现任总统若热·桑帕约有资格竞选第二个连续任期，并参加连任选举。他与此前的马里奥·苏亚雷斯和拉马略·埃亚内斯一样轻松连任，获得55%的选票，除布拉干萨外，在所有区均获胜。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.t: Final day of the Giant Baba Memorial Cup
en.s: The Giant Baba Memorial Cup, a professional wrestling memorial series organised by All Japan Pro Wrestling, concluded on January 14, 2002, at the Yokohama Bunka Gym in Japan. The series had begun on January 2 and visited several Japanese cities; those earlier stops did not all take place on January 14.
en.n: This entry records the final day of the series, not all of its earlier tour stops.

zh.s: 2002年1月14日，全日本职业摔角举办的巨人马场纪念杯系列赛，在日本横滨文化体育馆结束。系列赛于1月2日开始，先后到访日本多座城市；此前各站比赛并非都在1月14日举行。
zh.n: 此条记录的是系列赛的最后一天，并非此前巡回赛的所有场次。

en.s: The 2007 Final Resolution was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA), which took place on January 14, 2007, at the TNA Impact! Zone in Orlando, Florida. It was the third event under the Final Resolution chronology. Nine matches were contested at the event, with two being taped as dark matches.

zh.s: 2007年1月14日，TNA在美国佛罗里达州奥兰多的TNA Impact! Zone举办按次付费职业摔角赛事“最终决议”。这是该系列的第三届赛事，当天共安排9场比赛，其中2场作为非正式转播赛录制。

en.s: 2007 25th convocation local councils of Republic of Belarus elections were held on 14 January.

zh.s: 2007年1月14日，白俄罗斯共和国举行第25届地方议会选举。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; retained lead and separate occurrence-date infobox revision

en.s: The 2011 Republican National Committee (RNC) chairmanship election was held on January 14, 2011, to determine the next chairman of the RNC. After seven rounds of balloting, Reince Priebus was elected chairman over incumbent chair Michael Steele, Saul Anuzis, Ann Wagner and Maria Cino. Priebus won re-election with near unanimity in the party's 2013 meeting in Charlotte, North Carolina.

zh.t: 2011年美国共和党全国委员会主席选举
zh.s: 2011年1月14日，美国共和党全国委员会举行主席选举。经过七轮投票，赖因斯·普里巴斯击败现任主席迈克尔·斯蒂尔，以及索尔·阿努齐斯、安·瓦格纳和玛丽亚·奇诺，当选新主席。他后来在2013年于北卡罗来纳州夏洛特举行的党内会议上，以接近全票的支持率获连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: UFC 142: Aldo vs. Mendes was a mixed martial arts event held by the Ultimate Fighting Championship on January 14, 2012 at the HSBC Arena in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. It was the first UFC event of the year, and was broadcast live on pay-per-view in North America.

zh.s: 2012年1月14日，终极格斗冠军赛（UFC）在巴西里约热内卢汇丰竞技场，举办综合格斗赛事“UFC 142：阿尔多对阵门德斯”。这是UFC当年的首场赛事，在北美通过按次付费方式现场直播。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Taiwan on 14 January 2012. The election was held concurrently with legislative elections. It was the fifth direct election for the President of the Republic of China. Prior to 1996, the President was elected by the ROC's National Assembly and not directly by the people. Incumbent Ma Ying-jeou was re-elected as President with 51.6% of the vote.

zh.s: 2012年1月14日，台湾举行地区领导人选举，并与立法委员选举同步进行。这是第五次直接选举；1996年以前，由“国民大会”选出，而非民众直接投票。现任领导人马英九以51.6%的得票率连任。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; current article lead

en.s: A by-election was held in the Nanumaga constituency in Tuvalu on 14 January 2014. It followed the seat being declared vacant because of the ill-health of the incumbent Opposition MP Dr. Falesa Pitoi, on health grounds.

zh.s: 2014年1月14日，图瓦卢纳努芒加选区举行补选。现任反对党议员法莱萨·皮托伊医生因健康状况不佳，其席位被宣布空缺，因此需要补选。

events.attr: Wikipedia contributors; lead text extracted by DBpedia

en.s: The 2015 The Jewish Home leadership election was held on 14 January 2015 to elect the leader of The Jewish Home party. The election took place in advance of the 2015 Israeli legislative election. Incumbent leader Naftali Bennett was handily reelected. The election coincided with the primaries that determined the party's 2015 legislative election party list.

zh.s: 2015年1月14日，以色列“犹太人家园”党在当年议会选举前举行党魁选举，现任党魁纳夫塔利·贝内特轻松获连任。此次选举与决定该党议会选举候选人名单的党内初选同时举行。

en.s: On 14 January 2016, explosions and gunfire occurred near the Sarinah shopping mall in central Jakarta, Indonesia, around the intersection of Jalan Kyai Haji Wahid Hasyim and Jalan MH Thamrin. The attacks took place near a United Nations information centre, hotels and foreign embassies.

zh.s: 2016年1月14日，印度尼西亚雅加达市中心萨里娜商场附近、瓦希德·哈希姆街与坦林街交会处一带发生爆炸和枪击。事发地点邻近联合国新闻中心、酒店及外国使馆。

en.s: The 2017 United Kingdom Championship Tournament was a two-day professional wrestling livestreaming event and tournament promoted by the American promotion WWE. It was the inaugural United Kingdom Championship Tournament and aired exclusively on the WWE Network. The first round took place on January 14, 2017, while the finals occurred on January 15, with both nights airing at 8:00 p.m. Greenwich Mean Time (3:00 p.m.

zh.s: 2017年，WWE举办首届英国冠军锦标赛，为期两天，仅通过WWE Network进行网络直播。首轮于1月14日进行，决赛于1月15日进行，两晚均于格林尼治时间20时播出。原文还列出另一时区的“下午3时”，但时区说明在此处中断。

en.s: On 14 January 2019, a Boeing 707 operated by Saha Airlines on a cargo flight crashed at Fath Air Base, near Karaj, Alborz province in Iran. The aircraft was the last civil Boeing 707 in operation.

zh.t: 2019年伊朗萨哈航空波音707坠毁事故
zh.s: 2019年1月14日，萨哈航空一架执行货运航班的波音707，在伊朗厄尔布尔士省卡拉季附近的法特空军基地坠毁。它是当时最后一架仍在运营的民用波音707。

en.s: General elections were held in Uganda on 14 January 2021 to elect the President and the Parliament. The Electoral Commission announced Incumbent President Yoweri Museveni, the incumbent ruling since 1986, as the winner with 59% of the vote, although the U.S. State Department qualified the electoral process as "fundamentally flawed" and Africa Elections Watch said they observed irregularities.

zh.s: 2021年1月14日，乌干达举行总统和议会选举。选举委员会宣布，自1986年起执政的现任总统约韦里·穆塞韦尼，以59%的得票率获胜。但美国国务院称选举程序“存在根本性缺陷”，“非洲选举观察”组织也表示发现违规现象。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Czech Republic in January 2023, resulting in the election of Petr Pavel. Incumbent president Miloš Zeman was not eligible to run due to the two-term limit. The first round took place on 13 and 14 January. Petr Pavel, former chair of the NATO Military Committee, ran as an independent on a pro-Western, pro-European platform, and was one of three candidates backed by the centre-right governing alliance Spolu.
en.n: This entry records the first round, as dated in the source infobox.

zh.s: 2023年1月，捷克举行总统选举，彼得·帕维尔最终当选。现任总统米洛什·泽曼因两届任期限制而无法再次参选。首轮投票于1月13日至14日举行。曾任北约军事委员会主席的帕维尔，以亲西方、亲欧洲的独立候选人身份参选，也是中右翼执政联盟“一起”支持的三名候选人之一。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的首轮投票日期。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in the Comoros on 14 January 2024. Election officials initially announced on 16 January that incumbent president Azali Assoumani had been re-elected with 63% of the vote, with a voter turnout of just 16%. However, the Supreme Court approved a set of results that showed Assoumani receiving 57% of the vote, with voter turnout at 56%.

zh.s: 2024年1月14日，科摩罗举行总统选举。选举官员最初于1月16日宣布，现任总统阿扎利·阿苏马尼以63%的得票率连任，投票率仅16%。但最高法院批准的另一组结果显示，他获得57%的选票，投票率为56%。

en.s: The 2024 Supercopa de España final was a football match to decide the winner of the 2024 Supercopa de España, the 40th edition of the annual Spanish football super cup competition. The match was played on 14 January 2024 at the King Saud University Stadium in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

en.s: The abdication of Margrethe II as Queen of Denmark took place on 14 January 2024, the 52nd anniversary of her accession, being the first voluntary abdication of a Danish monarch since that of Eric III in 1146. Margrethe made the announcement of her abdication during her New Year's Eve address on 31 December 2023.

zh.t: 丹麦女王玛格丽特二世退位
zh.s: 2024年1月14日，丹麦女王玛格丽特二世在即位52周年当天退位，成为自1146年埃里克三世以来首位自愿退位的丹麦君主。她此前已在2023年12月31日的新年致辞中宣布这一决定。

en.s: On 14 January 2025, a by-election was held in the Antiguan parliamentary seat of St. Peter following the murder of Asot Michael. It was Antigua and Barbuda's third election since Prime Minister Gaston Browne emerged victorious in the 2023 general election. It was also the second by-election held outside of Barbuda since independence in 1981. At 23:24 AST, the election was called by ABS for Turner.

zh.s: 阿索特·迈克尔遇害后，安提瓜圣彼得议会选区于2025年1月14日举行补选。这是加斯顿·布朗总理赢得2023年大选后的第三次选举，也是该国1981年独立以来，巴布达岛以外地区举行的第二次补选。当晚大西洋标准时间23时24分，ABS宣布特纳胜选。

en.s: On 14 January 2026, at 09:13 (ICT; UTC+07:00), a construction crane fell on a passenger train with 157 passengers on board in Sikhio district, Nakhon Ratchasima province, Thailand, killing 30 and injuring 69 others.

zh.t: 泰国呵叻府西基奥列车事故
zh.s: 2026年1月14日泰国时间上午9时13分，一台施工起重机倒下，砸中呵叻府西基奥县一列载有157名乘客的客运列车，造成30人死亡、69人受伤。
